sloka: निष्प्रमाणशरीरः सन् लिलङ्घयिषुरर्णवम् ।बाहुभ्यां पीडयामास चरणाभ्यां च पर्वतम् ॥५-१-११॥
transliteration: niṣpramāṇaśarīraḥ san lilaṅghayiṣurarṇavam ।bāhubhyāṁ pīḍayāmāsa caraṇābhyāṁ ca parvatam ॥5-1-11॥

translations.english: Having swollen to an immeasurable figure, he pressed on the mountain with his feet and hands in an attempt to cross the ocean.
